title: OwnershipHistory
description: One assignment or transfer of a candidate's ownership. NEW in round 5. Rule: whoever imports a CV owns it (`owner_account_id` on the candidate, set once at creation). Re-uploading a CV and resolving a pending-upload as 'update' never change it - only POST /api/candidates/{id}/transfer-ownership does, and only for the current owner or an admin. The very first row for a candidate (written at creation) has from_owner_account_id = null.

from_owner_account_id.description: null on the very first (creation) row for a candidate. Otherwise the owner being moved away from.

changed_by.description: Who performed this transfer - the outgoing owner, or an admin overriding it. Can differ from from_owner_account_id when an admin does the moving.

reason.description: Optional free text, e.g. 'going on leave'. '' if not given.

endpoints.description: Not part of the payload - a summary of the API.
endpoints.POST /api/candidates/{id}/transfer-owner: Body: transferRequest. Allowed callers: the candidate's CURRENT owner, or any `admin` (override). Anyone else -> 403, including the account being made the new owner (a transfer is done TO an account, never something an account does to itself). 404 if new_owner_account_id does not exist, 400 if it is deactivated or is already the current owner. Returns the full updated Candidate.
endpoints.GET /api/candidates/{id}/ownership-histo: Any logged-in account. Every assignment/transfer for the candidate, newest first.
